text: Experiment 54 built tables from the solved messages' words, saw that no pair allows a number base below 16, and stopped; bases 16-26 were never checked on those tables. A positive control found the gap.

Every two- and three-term growth rule looking up to 13 digits back, in every base 16-26 a pair allows, three forms, needing six checks inside the known runs and then the stream carried to the second run; K4, ten copies, a planted text.
No rule fits K4 or any copy; the planted Gromark text is found. F5.3 closed.
